Thanks for sending the draft MSA + Order Form. Our security team reviewed the exhibit and we have a few clarifying asks before we can proceed to procurement: 

- SOC 2: Can Redwood confirm whether a SOC 2 Type II attestation will be provided at contract signature or within a fixed window (we typically require within 30 days of execution)? If there are subservice organizations, please list them.
- Pen test / forensic access: We need a clear definition of the pen-test window, notice required, and staging access model (ephemeral creds vs scheduled account).
- Evidence cadence: For logging/retention and audit artifacts (access logs, key rotation records, change history), can you propose an evidence delivery cadence (sample artifacts vs full package) and an SLA for turnaround on ad hoc requests?
- Data residency and inspection boundaries: Confirm what systems are in scope for inspection vs sampling.

I've attached our questionnaire to this thread (HealthCo_Security_Questionnaire.pdf). Can you designate a single point of contact on Redwood's side to coordinate the evidence handoff and pen-test scheduling?

Thanks,

Rafael — thanks. I reviewed HealthCo's questionnaire and the draft redlines. High level proposals below (I captured suggested contract phrasing in the attached redline-snippet.txt):

1) SOC 2 attestation
- Commit to providing the most recent SOC 2 Type II report within 30 days of the effective date where feasible. If the most recent period does not cover the customer’s effective date, provide the last available report and a statement of controls.
- List of subservice providers: AWS (us-east-1), GCP (for backups) — we will enumerate in the exhibit.

2) Pen-test & forensic access (recommended contract language)
- Pen-test window: Redwood will provide a standard testing window of up to 72 continuous hours per test.
- Notice: Standard tests require a minimum 10 business day notice. For emergency or accelerated testing, Redwood may agree to a 7-calendar-day notice if both parties agree in writing and additional operational guardrails are accepted (scoped IPs, test accounts, and defined rollback plan).
- Access model: Staging environment with ephemeral credentials and time-limited permissions. No production account credentials will be shared. Forensic access to logs/artifacts will be provided via a secure file transfer or temporary log viewer with scoped access.

3) Evidence cadence & SLAs
- Regular: Monthly evidence package (subset) that includes system access logs for the previous 30 days, summary of change history, and any exception reports.
- On-request: Standard ad hoc evidence requests will be fulfilled within 5 business days for items that can be exported from automated systems. If additional manual collection is required, Redwood will provide an ETA and deliver within 15 business days.
- Sampling: For operational artifacts (e.g., configuration snapshots), provide a quarterly sample set unless a specific audit is contracted.

4) Scope boundaries
- Exhibit will list in-scope systems and a short list of out-of-scope items (third-party SaaS used by Redwood).

Attachments: evidence-matrix.xlsx (operational mapping), redline-snippet.txt (contract language suggestions).

I recommend we send this as a single package to HealthCo and ask them to confirm the accelerated option if they need it. Happy to refine language for legal redlines.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Security & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence-matrix.xlsx; redline-snippet.txt

Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Apologies for the delay; I wanted to get Neha and Marissa's input before replying. Below is Redwood's consolidated proposal (we've attached a redlined exhibit). Please review and tell us any non-starters.

Summary of proposed exhibit items:
- SOC 2: Redwood will provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II attestation (or the last available report and controls statement) within 30 days of the effective date where available. We will enumerate subservice providers in the exhibit.
- Pen test windows: Standard test = up to 72 continuous hours with a minimum 10 business day notice. Accelerated test = 7-calendar-day notice (only by mutual written agreement + additional guardrails). Tests run against staging; no production credentials shared.
- Evidence cadence: Monthly automated evidence package (30-day logs + change summary). Standard ad hoc evidence exports fulfilled within 5 business days; complex/manual collections within 15 business days with an ETA communicated up front. Quarterly sampling for configuration artifacts unless a deeper audit is contracted.
- Scope: Exhibit will include an enumerated list of in-scope systems and out-of-scope third-party services.

Attachments: redlined-exhibit-v1.pdf (contains the exact redline language Neha prepared).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm HealthCo's preferred SOC 2 timing and whether the 30-day window is acceptable.
2) If the standard pen-test window is acceptable, confirm a target month so we can reserve staging capacity.
3) Share the legal contact for final redline review.

If it helps, Neha is available to jump on a short call with your security/legal team to walk through the redlines.

Thanks — Rafael
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
